title: 第7章引气第6章燃骨第5章入道
slug: 天行健君子以自强不息
content_zh:
【剧情回顾】
问剑殿，灯火彻明通宵。
九位元婴长老与掌门沈苍溟，连夜敲定林天行的归宿。他名义归入普通外门，所有待遇、考核、任务尽数从众；明面毫无特殊，暗地却被宗门层层看护、严密监控。
太上长老贺兰风仅有两成把握，却道出惊天秘辛：少年体内那缕微弱古朴的力量，大概率是绝迹万古的盘古本源精血。
伴随精血破封，六古神封印碎片的终极预言彻底现世：“当凡人之骨承吾血，六神之陨自此始。”
万古棋局、神魔变局，林天行全然不知。
苍云山巅晨光破晓，他心底只剩一个纯粹的执念：站稳脚跟，接走爹娘，远离贫苦。
入门仪式，尚余一时辰。
---
六月十一，午时，祖师殿。
九声钟鸣裂云，震彻整座苍云山。
祖师殿雄踞主峰平顶之巅，殿前九十九级青石长阶笔直垂落，气势巍峨。阶侧十二尊三丈汉白玉立像，皆是历代掌门遗容；石像托剑指天，风骨凛冽，千载未改。
殿门悬黑底金字巨匾，“玄天剑宗”四字锋芒毕露。传言此字由开派祖师剑气镌刻，两千三百年风雨冲刷，依旧锐利如新。
一百一十三名新弟子按灵根品级列队广场，秩序井然。
前排尽是本届顶尖天骄：慕容羽、夜七、苏云袖、铁战，外加两名上品灵根少年。中列、后列依次为中品、下品灵根弟子，层级分明。
林天行独居末排最侧。
全场唯独他无正统灵根，测灵却生异象。仅此一点，便注定他排位垫底，沦为全场异类。
身前的孟小虎悄悄回头，挤了挤眼。眼神直白又暖心：别怕，咱俩都是底层，谁也不比谁强。
林天行微微颔首，神色恬淡。
右手始终藏于袖中，手背金色纹路在正午烈阳下微微发烫。热度温顺平稳，远不及昨夜肉身淬炼时的灼痛刺骨。

晨起至今，他一直在默默体察身体异变。精血化入经脉的力量依旧微弱，却愈发驯服可控。
昨夜，这股力量如初生野蛇，窜动经脉，带来通体酸胀酥麻；今日，它静卧丹田之下，如一汪恒温暖泉，偶尔漾开细碎涟漪，安稳得超乎寻常。
丹田一词，是今早孟小虎随口提及。
孟小虎不懂修仙，却常年蹲守青州茶馆听说书，《玄天剑仙传》的段子烂熟于心。按他的说法，修士灵力储于下丹田，位在肚脐三寸之下。
林天行暗自比对，自身暖流栖息的位置，分毫不差。
“肃静！”
执事长老一声沉喝，瞬间压平全场细碎私语。
柳长老缓步出殿，身后两名执事弟子随行。一人捧宗门名册，一人端红绒托盘；崭新铜质腰牌整齐罗列，正面刻“玄天”，背面篆刻弟子姓名与外门编号，是所有新人的入门凭证。
“玄天剑宗立宗两千三百一十七年，今日纳新一百一十三人。”
柳长老声贯广场，字字落地有声，“入我宗门，必守三条铁律。”
“一，欺师灭祖者，杀！”
“二，残害同门者，杀！”
“三，勾结魔道者，杀！”
三句杀令，一声重过一声。
广场空气骤然凝滞，山风骤停。凛冽杀伐威压笼罩全场，压得一众新弟子心头紧绷，不敢妄动。
“三律之外，宗规一百二十条。三日内熟读背诵，违者重罚。”柳长老神色肃穆，“随我入殿，焚香拜祖。”
殿内恢弘气度，远胜外景。
大殿纵深三十丈，九根盘龙金柱分列两侧；龙纹栩栩如生，灵石镶嵌的龙目，在幽暗殿光中泛着幽幽冷光。
殿心深处，三丈青铜祖师神像巍然矗立。玄天上人衣袂飘然、手按长剑，面容清厉威严，目光俯瞰万古，审视着每一位新晋门人。
新弟子鱼贯入殿，三列肃立。殿中三柱檀香笔直冲天，青烟凝于殿顶，织成一层轻薄云雾，仙气氤氲。

入门古礼繁琐严苛，无半分疏漏。宣读训词、齐诵誓词、焚香叩拜、献礼敬祖，环环相扣，礼法周全。
林天行随众行礼，屈膝跪拜时，额头撞上冰凉青石板，发出一记闷响。
旁侧世家子弟跪拜姿势标准优雅，显然早有苦练。反观孟小虎，磕头用力过猛，起身时额头红了一大片。
他捂着额头小声吐槽：“这地砖也太硬了。”
content_en:
【Plot review】
The Wenjian Hall was brightly lit all night long.
The nine Yuanying elders and the leader Shen Cangming finalized Lin Tianxing's fate overnight. He was nominally classified as an ordinary outer sect, and all treatment, assessments, and tasks were all in line with the others. He was not special on the surface, but secretly he was guarded and closely monitored by the sect at all levels.
The Supreme Elder He Lanfeng was only 20% sure, but he revealed a shocking secret: the weak and primitive power in the young man's body was most likely the original essence and blood of Pangu that had disappeared forever.
As the essence and blood were broken, the ultimate prophecy of the seal fragments of the Six Ancient Gods came to light: "When the bones of mortals inherit my blood, the death of the Six Gods will begin."
Lin Tianxing has no idea about the eternal chess game and the changing dynamics of gods and demons.
The morning light broke on the top of Cangyun Mountain, and there was only one pure obsession left in his heart: to stand firm, take his parents away, and stay away from poverty.
There is still one hour left in the entrance ceremony.
---
June 11, at noon, the Patriarch Hall.
The nine bells tolled and split the clouds, shaking the entire Cangyun Mountain.
The Patriarch's Hall stands majestically on the flat top of the main peak. The ninety-nine long bluestone steps in front of the hall fall straight down and are majestic. Twelve three-foot-long white marble standing statues on the side of the steps are all the remains of the heads of the past dynasties; the stone statues point to the sky with swords in their hands, and their character is fierce and has not changed for thousands of years.
A huge plaque with gold characters on a black background hangs on the door of the palace, and the four characters "Xuantian Sword Sect" stand out clearly. It is rumored that this character was engraved by the sword energy of the founder of the sect. It has been washed away by wind and rain for 2,300 years and is still as sharp as new.
One hundred and thirteen new disciples lined up in the square according to their spiritual root levels in orderly order.
The front row is filled with the top geniuses of this year: Murong Yu, Ye Qi, Su Yunxiu, Tie Zhan, plus two young men with high-grade spiritual roots. The middle row and the back row are the middle-grade and low-grade spiritual root disciples, respectively, with clear hierarchy.
Lin Tianxing sits alone in the last row at the far side.
He was the only one in the audience who had no orthodox spiritual roots, but he had strange phenomena when he tested his spirit. This alone destined him to be at the bottom of the rankings and become an outlier in the field.
Meng Xiaohu in front of him quietly turned around and winked. His eyes are straightforward and heart-warming: Don’t be afraid, we are both at the bottom, no one is better than the other.
Lin Tianxing nodded slightly, his expression calm.
The right hand is always hidden in the sleeve, and the golden lines on the back of the hand are slightly hot under the scorching sun at noon. The heat was gentle and steady, far less painful than the burning pain last night when the body was being tempered.
Since waking up in the morning, he has been silently observing the changes in his body. The power of the essence and blood entering the meridians is still weak, but it is becoming more tame and controllable.
Last night, this force was like a newly born wild snake, swaying through the meridians, causing soreness, swelling and numbness throughout the body; today, it lay quietly under the Dantian, like a pool of ever-warm spring, occasionally making tiny ripples, and it was unusually stable.
The word Dantian was mentioned casually by Meng Xiaohu this morning.
Meng Xiaohu didn't know how to cultivate immortals, but he stayed at the Qingzhou teahouse all year round to listen to books, and he knew the passages in "The Legend of Xuantian Sword Immortal" by heart. According to him, a monk's spiritual power is stored in the lower Dantian, which is located three inches below the navel.
Lin Tianxing compared it secretly and found that the position where his own warm current resided was exactly the same.
"Quiet!"
The elder deacon shouted loudly, instantly quelling the murmurs in the audience.
Elder Liu slowly walked out of the hall, followed by two deacon disciples. One person is holding the sect roster, and the other is carrying a red velvet tray; brand-new copper waist badges are neatly arranged, with "Xuan Tian" engraved on the front, and the disciple's name and outer sect number on the back, which are the entry certificates for all newcomers.
"It has been two thousand three hundred and seventeen years since Xuantian Sword Sect was founded, and today it has admitted 113 new members."
Elder Liu's voice echoed across the square, and every word fell to the ground, "When you join our sect, you must abide by the three iron rules."
"One, kill those who deceive the master and destroy the ancestors!"
"Two, kill those who harm your fellow disciples!"
"Three, kill those who collude with the devil!"
Three killing orders, each one more important than the other.
The air in the square suddenly became stagnant, and the mountain breeze suddenly stopped. The fierce and murderous pressure enveloped the entire place, making the new disciples tense up and not daring to move rashly.
"In addition to the three laws, there are one hundred and twenty sect rules. Read and recite them within three days. Violators will be severely punished." Elder Liu looked solemn. "Follow me into the temple, burn incense and worship your ancestors."
The grandeur inside the palace is far superior to the scenery outside.
The main hall is thirty feet deep, with nineThe golden pillars with coiled dragons are arranged on both sides; the dragon patterns are lifelike, and the dragon eyes inlaid with spiritual stones glow with a faint cold light in the dark palace light.
Deep in the center of the hall, a three-foot-long bronze statue of the Patriarch stands majestically. Master Xuantian's clothes are fluttering, his hand is holding a long sword, his face is clear and majestic, his eyes overlook the eternity, and he examines every new disciple.
The new disciples filed into the hall and stood in awe in three rows. The three pillars of sandalwood in the hall soar straight to the sky, and the green smoke condenses on the top of the hall, weaving into a thin layer of clouds, and the fairy atmosphere is dense.
The ancient rituals for entry are complicated and strict, and there is no omission. Reading out the precepts, reciting the oaths, burning incense and bowing, and offering gifts to honor the ancestors are all closely linked and the etiquette is comprehensive.
Lin Tianxing saluted with the crowd, and when he knelt down to worship, his forehead hit the cold bluestone, making a muffled sound.
The disciples from the aristocratic family on the side kneel down in a standard and elegant posture, obviously they have practiced hard for a long time. Meng Xiaohu, on the other hand, kowtowed too hard and his forehead turned red when he stood up.
He covered his forehead and complained softly: "This floor tile is too hard."
